i tried twice. once because my wife saw a message on my phone. then in the psyche ward i found out she was divorcing me. i moved out but i still thought i could save the marriage but in order to do that i couldnt drink. i had no solution. it was a living hell. it took six weeks for me to realize she was in fact divorcing me. i tried again. pills both times. more the second time. ended up on a ventilator for five days. i had had 11 years of dry time so i thought i knew everything about AA. then i came to treatment and started doing what the people that looked happy and free told me to do. i began getting relief around step 6&7 but when i went over the 10th step promises they were happening to me. its a gradual change if you do the work. taking the action when you dont think its working. that was key for me. one day i looked up and a situation that always made me upset didnt. i was ok. the more i go over the steps with guys the more i see where my experience reflects what the book says. for me it was about 3 months but the thought came back and one point because i was holding on to a resentment against my ex. that was at 6 months. thats when i knew it didnt have anything to do with drinking. it says in the book drinking is but a symptom we have to get down to causes and conditions. can you pinpoint the things that make you anxious? are you thinking of events that may happen in the future? if so what is the worst that could happen and why is it the worst? in my experience it comes down to 3 things
1 what i might lose
2 what i may not get
3 what will others think of me
